messages:
sam (newhire): Hey all — trying to get the local stack running on my M1 Mac. docker-compose up shows postgres container exiting with:

sam (newhire): ERROR: could not create socket "/var/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432": Address already in use

sam (newhire): I think macOS has a local postgres on 5432. What's the easiest safe way to run the Compose setup without touching my system postgres?

anya: Easiest is to remap the host port in your compose file so container binds to a different host port, e.g.:

anya: ```yaml
  postgres:
    image: postgres:14-alpine
    ports:
      - "15432:5432"  # host:container
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: example
```

anya: Then update your app env to use port 15432 on localhost, or set DATABASE_URL accordingly.

mike (devex): If you want the app to still use 5432 internally, keep the container port as-is (5432) and only change the left side (host). No need to change the DB config inside the container.

irene: For M1/ARM, prefer `postgres:14-alpine` or `postgres:14-bullseye` has multi-arch builds, but avoid old `:latest` tags. If you see exec format errors, try `platform: linux/amd64` as a fallback (slower).

sam (newhire): sweet — thx. Any tips for connecting from my host psql client?

anya: From your host: `psql -h localhost -p 15432 -U postgres` (or use the password you set). If you want to run psql inside the container use: `docker-compose exec postgres psql -U postgres`

mike (devex): Also check volume ownership if DB init scripts fail. On mac, permissions often cause `initdb` to error. Quick fix: `docker-compose down -v` then remove the volume and `docker-compose up` again. Or run a one-off chown from a helper container: `docker run --rm -v your_postgres_data:/data alpine chown -R 999:999 /data`

sam (newhire): got a `permission denied` on the mounted data dir earlier. that chown trick sounds good.

irene: FYI we have a short doc in onboarding (link below) that mentions these exact steps and common gotchas for Mac.

devx-bot: https://redwood-inference.internal/docs/onboarding/local-services.md :point_right: "Local Postgres & Docker tips"

sam (newhire): awesome, that solves it. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

anya: np — ping me if you want a quick screen-share to sort the compose file. :thumbsup:
